name: @semanaut/zpi-peer
description: pi extension: equal, durable pi peers managed through tmux panes plus a letter channel between any pi sessions. tmux runs on Unix-like systems (Linux, macOS, BSD; Windows via WSL/Cygwin); native Windows is not supported. Tools: peer_spawn (launch a peer in a tmux pane), peer_list (list peers, alive or exited), peer_send_mail (deliver a letter, reviving dead recipients). Ships investigator / strategist / auditor role prompts; developed against the pi version given by the piVersion field
